The execution failed because the generated summary lacked the mandatory 'Decision:' keyword, despite producing correct numerical calculations.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in 'test_summary_contains_key_outputs' because 'Decision:' was missing from the summary text. While the model correctly calculated revenue values ($72766.88 vs $52993.95) and provided a 'Recommendation:', the test specifically requires the exact string 'Decision:'. Avoid omitting required headers in the final summary output at /tests/test_outputs.py.
